blocks.text: United States-based Filipino singer and nurse Carol Banawa was honored with the Most Outstanding Migrant Award at the 2026 Global Migrant Award Heritage People’s Ball in the United States. Banawa expressed her gratitude for the accolade through her Instagram page on Monday, Sept. 21. She accepted the recognition during the ceremony held last Saturday, Sept. 19. “I am deeply humbled and incredibly honored to be one of the recipients of the Most Outstanding Migrant Award. To be recognized among so many inspiring individuals is a blessing I will forever cherish,” said the “Iingatan Ka” singer. Banawa recalled leaving her showbiz career […]...
